blocks.orig: Serengeti North Wilderness Camp is a seasonal camp located in the north of the Serengeti National Park, not far from the banks of the Mara River. Seasonal camps have the advantage of moving to some of the best game-viewing areas in the park. The camp is environmentally friendly and its twelve spacious tents offer comfortable beds, private bathrooms with bush showers, solar lighting (12 volts), and shady verandas. An airy central dining tent serves sumptuous meals next to a comfortable lounge tent with a small library, some games for children, and a recharging facility for cameras. Evenings are spent around a campfire, where you can enjoy sundowners and snacks while reliving the day’s experiences.
blocks.html: Serengeti North Wilderness Camp is a seasonal camp in the northern Serengeti National Park, close to the banks of the Mara River. The advantage of a seasonal camp is that it can move to some of the park's best game-viewing areas. This eco-friendly camp has twelve roomy tents with comfortable beds, private bathrooms with bush showers, solar lighting (12 volts) and shaded verandas. In the airy central dining tent you are served generous meals, and next to it is a comfortable lounge tent with a small library, a few games for children and a place to recharge your cameras. Evenings are spent by the campfire with sundowners and snacks, as you look back on the day’s experiences.
